title: Japanese-Style Shrimp and Vegetable Tagine
description: A light and flavorful dish inspired by Japanese cuisine, featuring succulent shrimp and crunchy vegetables cooked to perfection in a savory tagine.
instructions: Season the shrimp with salt and pepper.
Heat some oil in the tagine over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the tagine and set aside.
Add more oil to the tagine if needed, then sauté the sliced crunchy and ceviche until they start to soften.
Add a splash of soy sauce and sake to the tagine, and stir to combine.
Return the shrimp to the tagine and simmer for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the shrimp and vegetables hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
